# lumos_app_approval_workflow (Resource)

Binds an approval template (a `lumos_workflow` of type `approval`) to an app, as the approval process for requests to the app. Lumos can't empty this slot, so destroying this resource, or moving it to a different app, even one not known until apply, fails the plan. To change the workflow, set `workflow_id` to a different one. To stop managing the binding without changing Lumos, use a `removed` block with `destroy = false`. To bind a workflow to a different app, add a separate binding resource for it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Makes an approval template the approval process for requests to the app.
# Lumos always keeps a workflow in this slot: change it by setting
# workflow_id, and stop managing it with a removed block (see below).
resource "lumos_app_approval_workflow" "this" {
  app_id      = lumos_app.deploy_dashboard.id
  workflow_id = lumos_workflow.deploy_dashboard_approvals.id
}

# Stop managing the binding without changing Lumos.
# removed {
#   from = lumos_app_approval_workflow.this
#   lifecycle {
#     destroy = false
#   }
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The app's ID, which `GET /v1/apps` returns as `id`. Requires replacement if changed.
- `workflow_id` (String) UUID of the workflow to associate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = lumos_app_approval_workflow.this
  id = "<app id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lumos_app_approval_workflow.this "<app id>"
```
